inputs: Unique test output directories, per-worker UUIDs and a scoped thread barrier.
sideEffects: Creates isolated temporary staging directories; joins all threads before removing the fixture.
errors: The unpatched test reproduced Windows error 183; all other I/O and unsafe-layout errors remain failures.
ownership: Scoped test threads own distinct operation directories.
locks: Test barrier aligns 32 callers; no production lock or synchronization exception added.
invariants: Each successful worker gets its own verified marker; the fixture is removed only after every worker has joined.
tests: cargo test --lib --features local-preview: 396 passed, 4 ignored, including the new simultaneous staging regression and existing path/marker tests.
evidence: Native failure evidence: target/qc-native-20260919-r2; red regression: nuclear-app/src-tauri/target/qc-code-audit/staging-race-before.log; green suite: rust-preview-final.log.
entries.purpose: Exercise 32 simultaneous legitimate staging initializations against each of four fresh destinations and verify each operation marker.
entries.output: Regression assertions and cleanup of the owned fixture.
entries.cancellation: No asynchronous work is introduced; scoped test threads are joined and existing staging cleanup ownership remains unchanged.
entries.reviewer: Codex native QC follow-up source review
entries.notes: Native multi-download QC exposed an existing create-if-missing race. Accepting AlreadyExists is followed by the same identity and containment checks, including for newly created roots.
